title: Consider adding an alternate ending path where the player can retrieve the king's crown from the elder and place it on the throne instead of speaking verses, for replayability
The verse locations (drowned shrine, watchtower, eastern ash wood) were never explored—game communicated them clearly but the crown path was more direct; both paths seem viable

Clarify NPC intent early: the notice board hints at two paths, but the game strongly guides toward verses (priest opens doors for free, elder won't talk about crown until after barrow). Make the crown path equally viable or acknowledge it as the 'harder' route
The two-ending choice (seal vs open barrow) is impactful but could be more salient before reaching the throne — perhaps hint at the reeve/priest conflict in the notice board more explicitly
Consider showing a mini-map or clearer exit descriptions in the dense forest areas to reduce backtracking.
Consider adding more NPC interactions after initial conversations (reeve, priest could respond to player choices)
Consider a 'skip travel' shortcut after first visit to reduce backtracking (helpful: direct trail to barrow was offered)
The hunter mentioned by the innkeep (at west edge, trades herbs) was never encountered — either remove the mention or create that location for consumable mechanics
Add a discovery or NPC encounter that hints at the hidden passage under the lintel stone before the player reaches Barrow Field
Navigation required backtracking—the map felt slightly disconnected in places (e.g., getting from barrow back to village chapel took 5+ turns through intermediate rooms)
Watchtower verse required WITS checks (scholar-like reading) rather than GRACE/Scout skills — unexpected for decoding wind carvings
The hunter at the west edge was mentioned by innkeeper but never encountered—consider adding them for additional flavor or quests
Barrow sealing choice seemed implicit rather than explicit—no direct 'seal barrow' action available; outcome was automatic based on verses-open vs crown-sealed paths
The two different endings (verses vs crown) and their moral implications could be stated more explicitly during setup to help players understand what they're choosing between.
Innkeep said scouts can trace the shrine verse 'by touch' without checks, but I still had to roll a grace check (though it succeeded). Minor inconsistency between flavor text and mechanics.
Add more direct shortcuts between major hubs (village ↔ chapel ↔ barrow) to reduce empty traversal
Add one or two more flavor encounters in the Ashwood (e.g., the hunter's camp at Split Oak was mentioned but never explored—great opportunity for a side quest or lore)
Label hostile NPCs more carefully—the Hollow King was hostile but only needed dialogue, not combat
